notes.title: Bee’s Lands — new update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! It’s been nearly a month — but we haven’t been idle 🐝
The last few weeks have been super productive: we created a bunch of new concepts for upcoming locations and added ambient soundscapes to support the game’s atmosphere.

This is build 0.0.7 MVP pre-alpha — another internal step forward for the project.

We’ve added the concept for a new zone: Bee’s Lands — one of the most unique areas in the game.
We also added ambient audio to a few key places: Sweet Fields, Sweet Field Factory, and Bee’s Farmland.

We want every zone to sound, breathe, and have its own mood.

The world keeps growing — see you in the next update!

— Mark

notes.title: Sweet Fields — new release!
notes.notes:
Hello! A fresh update — small but meaningful.
We’ve introduced a concept for a new location: “Sweet Fields”. It's not just a pretty spot — it plays an important role in understanding the world of the game.
We’ve also added ambience for “Islands” and “Tavern”, plus some deeper, stranger areas: “Roots”, “Teeth” and “Heart”.
Zone loading and world scene transitions have been fixed — no more falling into the void. And we’ve done some asset cleanup to make everything look the way it should.
See you in the next release!
— Mark

notes.title: Sprint Update — World Loading, New Sounds, and Bee’s Farm!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We continue working on the foundations of the game and gradually filling the world with new details.
In this sprint, we optimized scene loading, improved the control system, and expanded content for upcoming locations.

Previously, we divided the world into smaller scenes, and this week we focused on speeding up their loading as the player moves through them.
We also updated the Input System to support a wider range of device configurations and ability setups.

Among visual updates — a new concept art for the next location, which we call Bee’s Farm 🐝.
On the sound front — we’ve added ambient tracks for several key locations: “Dried Lake”, “Dragon Cave”, “Tower”, and “Path to the Fields”.

We also made minor adjustments to the camera behavior to ensure smoother and more stable gameplay.

Thank you for staying with us!
There’s still a lot of work ahead, but each sprint makes the world of Syncope a little bigger and more alive.

Mark

notes.title: Patch v0.0.4 Pre-Alpha — Smoother Movement, Seamless World
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Another two weeks have passed — which means a new sprint and a new internal update: version 0.0.4.

This time, we focused on making character movement feel more natural and pleasant:
we added Inverse Kinematics so the feet actually touch the ground,
and adjusted movement speeds in different states to make everything smoother —
whether you're in the air, underwater, or under effects like slow or hypnosis.

We're continuing to enrich the world with new content:
zone loading has been implemented to make transitions between areas seamless,
and we’ve continued working on atmosphere — with the first ambient tracks and new visual concepts.

Thanks for following the development.
See you again in two weeks!

— Mark
